selection_reason: APW-04 completed_verified in PR #421, satisfying APM-02 dependencies APM-01, APW-03 and APW-04. The owner-approved interleave now selects APM-02 before CSW-03.
objective: Define CozyMode Core Loop as a setting-independent low-pressure automated-play experience hosted primarily in Personal context at first, using APW-03 bounded Activity/Project primitives and APM-01 explicit delegation to automate only routine bounded operations while stopping at human/GM choices, resource/time limits, stale state, consent boundaries and uncertainty.
completion_gate: Cozy Solo has a complete bounded low-pressure loop with explicit user preferences/delegation, activity selection, deterministic/domain-owned progress, human-choice/consent stop points, bounded background behavior, summaries/notifications, no-AI fallback, safe save/exit/resume and no setting-specific or unrestricted autonomy assumptions.
required_design_questions: What makes CozyMode low-pressure without making it a genre or removing meaningful choices?
What is the smallest useful Cozy Solo loop over APW-03 Activities/Projects?
Which routine operations may be preauthorized automatically and which always stop for the user/GM?
How are time, step/event, resource, Asset, cost and notification budgets configured?
How does background progression work when the app closes, and what stops it?
How are relationship/social activities handled without automated consent or guaranteed NPC response?
How are advancement, investigation and crafting safety boundaries inherited?
What are the manual/deterministic no-AI presentation and choice paths?
How are summaries, journals and project memory written without turning generated narrative into truth?
How does Cozy Solo transition to/from ordinary Personal or Campaign play and later Connected Cozy?
next_action: Execute APM-02 as a bounded design/governance tranche using APM-01 delegation, APW-03 Campaign Activity primitives and APW-04 Personal host context to define Cozy Solo loop, preference/budget profiles, bounded-background stop conditions, summaries/recovery and no-AI fallback.
